title: FPL Squad Planner
tagline: Plan a squad against live prices, load in your own team, check fixture difficulty, and track player availability
highlights: Two data strategies matched to two data shapes: a GitHub Action refreshes shared prices, fixtures, and injury news twice daily into static files, while a Vercel serverless function proxies personal team/history lookups live
Squad planner, team lookup with gameweek-by-gameweek history, fixture-difficulty view, and an injury/availability feed all draw from the same player dataset

Deliberately doesn't fabricate two numbers the public API can't reliably support (free transfers remaining, and last season's result vs the same fixture) — shows what's verifiable and says plainly why the rest isn't shown
